scope: Restart retained endpoints; verify automatic four-tunnel/BGP recovery and bidirectional encrypted healthy-state reachability; capture requested control-plane state.

checks.assertion: Four VPN gateway external BGP sessions Connected, each receiving one prefix
Four CPE CHILD_SAs installed before and after the traffic sample
CPE-to-Azure: source-bound ICMP 10/10 and TCP22 connected
Azure-to-CPE: source-bound ICMP 10/10 and TCP22 connected
Trace correlates workload ICMP with private UDP-encapsulated ESP
CPE has two private localpref 200 multipaths and two Internet localpref 100 paths
Full FRR neighbor detail reports four Established sessions without drops
ER primary carries outer /32 but no overlay workload prefix
ER secondary carries outer /32 but no overlay workload prefix
Google underlay BGP Established/UP, advertising only CPE outer /32

finalState: Both VMs running. Gateways/provider products were already live and were not reset. No VPN/BGP/PSK/configuration changes.
changes: Added existing operator SSH public key with a two-hour expiry for IAP access; host key fingerprint pinned.
Invoked Azure Run Command twice; initial inline script returned no test output, corrected file-based script completed the reverse probes.
limits: One observed boot recovered successfully, not a guarantee of future boot ordering: systemd logged an ordering cycle and dropped network-online.target start jobs.

MCR/VXCs are LIVE, but looking-glass routes are empty and VXC bgp_status is null. Do not equate these responses with established MCR BGP. Remote Azure/Google summaries and actual encrypted payload provide separate evidence.
FRR per-peer routes are accepted/post-policy learned routes, not unfiltered Adj-RIB-In. No soft-reconfiguration or route-refresh was enabled for collection.
ER gateway learned overlay prefix via VPN-gateway iBGP; the ER circuit and Google router do not carry that overlay workload prefix.
Failover/failback, customer migration and Palo Alto-specific behavior were not tested.
All four tunnels carried BGP; the workload packet sample used private1 and is not independent payload validation of every backup tunnel.
sanitization: Explicit 30-record allowlist. Raw project SSH metadata, operator public keys, serial logs, VM metadata/certificates, account IDs and credentials are excluded. Subscription GUIDs are redacted; lab addresses retained.
